info.name: Petso - VPS (95.216.63.81)
info.description:
Full Petso API collection. Default **`base_url`**: `http://95.216.63.81:8000` â€” edit the collection variable if your server IP or port changes.

Includes: vet registration with license PDF, admin vet verification, auth (`/auth/me/`, login with `user_id`), public farmers/vets lists, e-commerce (form-data products, bulk delete staff), medical slots, social like, chat, AI, system.
Run `python tools/build_postman_collection.py` to regenerate.

request.description:
**VPS server** â€” default `base_url`: `http://95.216.63.81:8000` (edit the collection variable if your host/port differs).

**Suggested flow:**
1. Register users â†’ Login (tokens auto-saved) â†’ follow folders in order.
2. Set `admin_email` / `admin_password` for staff-only routes (bulk delete, etc.).

**Key features:**
- Login returns `user_id`, `email`, `name`, `role` with JWT tokens.
- Public lists (no auth): farmers `/all/`, vets `/all/`, slots `?vet=<user_id>`.
- Vet reviews & appointments include `vet_name` and `farmer_name`.
- Vet updates appointment status: `PATCH .../appointments/{id}/update-status/` â†’ `accepted / finished / rejected`.
- Cart: `add_item`, `remove_item`, `update_item` actions.
- Orders: auto-filled from cart items on create; cart cleared automatically after order.
- All tables have `DELETE .../delete-all/` (staff JWT required) + single `DELETE /{id}/`.

**Variables:** base_url, admin_*, role emails/passwords, tokens, *_id fields

item.name: 01 - Authentication

request.description: Creates farmer account; `is_verified` is true â€” login with JWT immediately.
Set `admin_email` and `admin_password` collection variables to match your VPS `createsuperuser` account. Needed for staff-only routes (e.g. bulk delete products/categories).
Returns the logged-in user's profile: id, email, name, phone_number, role, is_verified, date_joined. Requires Bearer token (any role).

Confirms the user's email address. The `token` is in the confirmation link sent after registration.

Success: `{ "message": "Email confirmed successfully. You can now log in." }`

Error: `{ "detail": "Invalid or expired confirmation token." }`

Resends the confirmation email if the account is not yet verified.

Always returns 200 to prevent user enumeration.

request.description:
Buyer (farmer/vet): returns orders placed by the authenticated user.

Admin: all orders; optional filters `?company=3&status=pending`.

Login as a **company** user (e.g. `company.demo@petso.local` / company id **3**). Returns incoming orders for that vendor's store (`order.company.user == request.user`). No `?company=` query param needed — scoped automatically by role.

Creates an order from the **current cart items** â€” add products to cart first via **Cart - Add item**.

`total` is calculated automatically from cart items. `user`, `order_number`, `status` are set by the server.

After a successful order the cart is **cleared automatically**.

Response includes the full order with `items` (product_name, quantity, unit_price, total_price).

Login as a **company** user (vendor). Updates status for an order on that vendor's store only (`order.company.user == request.user`).

Allowed statuses: `pending`, `confirmed`, `processing`, `shipped`, `delivered`, `cancelled`.

Creates an `OrderStatusHistory` row (`old_status`, `new_status`, `changed_by`).

Farmers/vets cannot call this endpoint (403). Admin can update any order.

Response: `200` full order JSON (same shape as create/list).
Buyer: history for orders they placed. **Company vendor**: history for orders on their store (same scoping as List orders). Admin: all history.
DELETE /api/orders/orders/{{order_id}}/ â€” 204 No Content.
No auth required. Filter by vet user_id: `?vet={{vet_user_id}}`. Filter available: `?is_available=true`. Filter by date: `?date=YYYY-MM-DD`.
Filter slots by vet **user_id** (the `user_id` returned at login). No auth required. Also supports `?is_available=true` and `?date=YYYY-MM-DD`.
Login as **vet**. `vet` is assigned automatically from JWT â€” do not include it in body. Run **Create vet profile** first.
Vet marks their slot as unavailable (or any field update).
Set slot_id from **Add slot** or **List all slots**.

Vet changes the appointment status. Login as **vet**.

Allowed values: `accepted`, `finished`, `rejected`.

Staff can also set `scheduled` or `cancelled`.

Response: full appointment object with updated status.
DELETE /api/medical/slots/{{slot_id}}/ â€” 204 No Content.
DELETE /api/medical/appointments/{{appointment_id}}/ â€” 204 No Content.
DELETE /api/medical/prescriptions/{{prescription_id}}/ â€” 204 No Content.

Default flow: Body **form-data**. `content` = **Text**; `image` = **File** (Select Files). Same pattern as **Create product**. If Postman shows a **yellow warning** on the filename, re-pick the file. Leave headers empty. On VPS, nginx: `client_max_body_size 10m;` for `/api/`.
Alternative: JSON with `remote_image_url` (server downloads). For a **local file**, use **Create post** (form-data + `image` File).
Optional fallback only if multipart is blocked. Prefer **Create post** (form-data + File).

Toggle like on a post. First call **likes** the post; second call **unlikes** it. Response: `{ "liked": true/false, "likes_count": <int> }`. Requires Bearer token. The post list also returns `is_liked_by_me` and `likes_count`.

GET /api/ai/poultry/index-status/ â€” Check how many chunks are indexed and whether the RAG index is ready.

POST /api/ai/poultry/build-index/ â€” Admin only. Reads all PDFs from data/poultry_pdfs/, generates embeddings with Gemini, and persists them in ChromaDB. Must be called at least once before using diagnose or chat endpoints.

POST /api/ai/poultry/diagnose/ â€” Upload a photo of a sick chicken. Returns AI diagnosis including disease name, symptoms, treatment, prevention, and severity level. Uses RAG from poultry disease PDFs.

item.description:
One `DELETE .../delete-all/` per table. All require a **staff JWT** (`is_staff=True`). Login as a superuser (`python manage.py createsuperuser`) then use **Login - Admin**.

âڑ ï¸ڈ These are **irreversible**. Use with care.
